verdict.rationale: Viam's automations are logic modules, and the docs say Viam manages their source code, builds, versioning, and deployment for inline modules. The platform also advertises canary testing and rollbacks for safe versioning of OTA software updates, so versioning and rollback of automation code are claimed. Model version/stage/rollback covers ML models rather than automations, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: any documented review or approval workflow before deploying automation changes, detailed docs on how to roll back a specific module or automation version, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
